title: refactor(Formalism): share diamond matching lemmas between cross-place and same-place Hecke proofs
body:
Unify the duplicated down-matching and up-matching local transport proofs shared between `HeckeRamifiedZeroOfMatchingsAndDu.lean` and `HeckeRamifiedZeroAll.lean`.

Changes:
- Moves `SameDiaZero.dnk_latP_smul` from `HeckeRamifiedZeroAll.lean` to `CrossDiaZero.dnk_latP_smul` in `HeckeRamifiedZeroOfMatchingsAndDu.lean`, and removes the specialized `CrossDiaZero.dnk_latP` from `DnkLkLocP.lean`.
- Adds `CrossDiaZero.dn_match_core` in `HeckeRamifiedZeroOfMatchingsAndDu.lean` for an arbitrary nonzero scaling factor `μ`, generalizes `CrossDiaZero.dn_match_one` to take `hδv` directly via `dn_match_core`, updates `CrossDiaZero.dnDiaMatch0F_holds` and `SameDiaZero.dn_same_loc`, removes duplicate `SameDiaZero.dn_match_gen` from `HeckeRamifiedZeroAll.lean`, and updates `SameDiaZero.eSame_one` to call `CrossDiaZero.dn_match_one`.
- Generalizes `CrossDiaZero.upF` in `HeckeRamifiedZeroOfMatchingsAndDu.lean` to take the lattice transport `hLd`, multiplier `k`, and class-function hypothesis `hfun`, removes duplicate `SameDiaZero.upFSame` from `HeckeRamifiedZeroAll.lean`, and updates `CrossDiaZero.upMatch` and `SameDiaZero.upSame_one`.
